cap: Welcome! This box holds 3 glycine molecules (the simplest amino acid) in 90 waters. Colors: red O, white H, grey C, blue N. The motion is a synthetic demo, not a real simulation. Press play, or use Next stop.
Each molecule now has its own color. Find the three glycines among the waters. Each is a chain N–C–C with two O on the end.
Bulk water is hidden. Only waters within 4 Å of a glycine are shown: this is the solvation shell. Watch waters join and leave it as you play.
Cyan dashes are hydrogen bonds between glycine and water (H···O or H···N at most 2.5 Å, angle at least 120°). Which glycine atoms make the most H-bonds?
Two glycine N atoms are selected. The plot shows their distance over the whole run (click it to jump to a frame), and the paths show where each one went.
End of the tour. Try other styles, pick atoms yourself, or press Enter VR to walk around the box.
